item.title: Tacoma police seek 2 suspects in New Year's Day fatal shooting
item.description: Tacoma police need help finding two suspects in a fatal shooting at a house party on New Year's Day.

item.title: Seattle weather: Dry start to the week, rain returns next weekend
item.description: We are in for a dry, chilly and cloudy start to the week around the Seattle area, before cold rain makes a return just in time for the Seahawks' NFC Championship Game.

item.title: Zach Charbonnet to miss rest of season for Seattle Seahawks with "significant knee injury"
item.description: Seattle Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet will miss the remainder of the playoffs with a knee injury that requires surgery, coach Mike Macdonald said in a local radio interview on Monday.

item.title: Seattle's Dick's Drive-In celebrates 72 years with 19-cent Burger Days
item.description: Dick’s Drive-In is celebrating its 72nd anniversary with 19-cent hamburgers and cheeseburgers January 26–29, with exclusive merch available at select locations.

item.title: Connor Dewar scores twice as Seattle Kraken lose 6-3 to Penguins
item.description: Brett Kulak broke a second-period tie with his first goal of the season, and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Seattle Kraken 6-3 on Monday.

item.title: Missing Kitsap, WA woman rescued, allegedly kidnapped by sex offender
item.description: The search for a missing Kitsap County woman is over. Investigators said she has the mental capacity of a 10-year-old and was with a convicted sex offender she'd met online.

item.title: How much do tickets to the Rams vs Seahawks NFC championship cost?
item.description: The Seahawks take on the Rams in the NFC Championship this Sunday at Lumen Field, and the 12s are preparing in all sorts of ways.

item.title: Peso Pluma to kick off U.S. tour at Seattle's Climate Pledge Arena
item.description: Mexican music icon Peso Pluma has announced an upcoming U.S. tour, with the first stop being in Seattle's Climate Pledge Arena.

item.title: Video captures driver run over man outside of Seattle pot shop
item.description: A budtender was seriously injured in a hit-and-run outside Kemp's Cannabis in Seattle, and the incident was caught on surveillance video.

item.title: Seahawks Notebook: Moving forward without Zach Charbonnet
item.description: If the Seattle Seahawks are going to advance to the Super Bowl, they're going to have to do so without running back Zach Charbonnet.
